harvested_sources.title: Vanta
harvested_sources.summary:
Vanta is a private, San Francisco–based software development company (founded 2018) that automates security and compliance certification. It offers an end-to-end Trust Platform for continuous GRC (governance, risk, compliance), including automated evidence gathering, continuous monitoring, and risk management across SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI, and GDPR. Key features include:
- Continuous compliance and risk management
- Trust Center for public security posture
- Questionnaire automation with AI-assisted first-pass responses
- Over 375 integrations and 1,200+ automated tests
- AI-powered control mapping, evidence checks, and remediation
- Private company with 1,316 employees (distributed across 19 countries); headquartered in San Francisco
- 15,000+ customers (including Atlassian, Duolingo, Icelandair, Ramp, Synthesia)
- Notable investors: Sequoia, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Goldman Sachs Growth, CrowdStrike Ventures
- Leadership and recent changes available on public profiles (senior roles include VP of Products, Director of Engineering, and other executives)

harvested_sources.summary:
Summary:
- Vanta reports over $300 million ARR, up 63% YoY and tripling since 2024, driven by AI and Risk offerings.
- The company’s growth is accelerating with its Agentic Trust Platform, including the Vanta Agent and Trust Graph, and serves 16,000+ organizations (e.g., Atlassian, Samsara, Snowflake; startups like Harvey, Lovable, Cursor).
- Key product highlights:
  - Vanta Agent: 24/7 GRC engineer that automates and coordinates security/compliance work, continuous monitoring, tailored remediation, and vendor assessments.
  - Trust Graph: integrated, 400+ deep integrations that map tests, evidence, and risks to support a continuous security posture.
  - Third Party Risk Management (TPRM): automates full vendor risk lifecycle, speeds assessments by up to 50%, and ties findings to 35+ compliance frameworks and audit workflows.
- Market context cited: 70% of companies have shadow AI; LLMs are 52% more likely to be high risk in Vanta’s assessments.
- Company positioning: pursuing “Agentic Trust” by shifting from point-in-time checks to continuous monitoring and proof of security postures.

Vanta announces a $150 million Series D, valuing the company at $4.15 billion. Since its 2018 SOC 2 automation roots, Vanta has expanded to continuous trust with new products (Compliance Roadmap, Policy Builder, Vendor Discovery) and aims to support over 12,000 companies in scaling security and GRC. The release highlights:
- Financing milestone validating growth and mission
- Focus on continuous trust beyond point-in-time compliance
